== Biography ==

Two is one of three gardeners tending the Queen's roses. When Alice encounters them in the rose garden, Two speaks for the group, explaining in a low voice their pressing situation: they had mistakenly planted a white rose-tree where a red one should have grown. Should the Queen discover the error, Two and fellow gardeners Five and Seven would all face execution. Two works with Five and Seven to correct the mistake by repainting the white roses red before the Queen arrives.
